name: dsh-process-fold
description: Fold each DSH Web turn's thinking, tool calls and context into compact expandable process boxes cut at every piece of model text, and reuse the shipped turn-process disclosure row as the toggle whenever it exists.

summary.en: Folds each DSH Web turn's thinking, tool calls and context into bordered process boxes cut at every piece of model text; each box shows its latest two items, with a clickable stack above its border to open it and the border itself to fold it back.
summary.zh: 把 DSH Web 每轮的思考、工具调用与上下文折叠进带边框的过程框，在每段模型文本处切开；每个框只显示最新两项，上边框的堆叠线可点击展开、再点边框收起。
